Type.evidence_source: We found such a phenomenological hermeneutic approach useful when we wanted to analyse and understand how the meaning was constructed in personal narratives.

Area.evidence_source: We regard emigration, substance abuse and suicidal behaviour as such disruptive activities (Eastmond, 2007). When ontologically subjective phenomena are intersubjectively communicated and are tested using qualitative methodology (Barbosa da Silva & Wahlberg, 1994), such scientifically based knowledge may prove important if it contributes to new perceptions and to the development of services offered to male immigrants, especially when they face existential challenges. The knowledge gained from this study may help to widen the understanding of clinicians, researchers and others about emigration, substance abuse and suicidal behaviour, and the impact on health, well-being and coping.
